# langfuse_organization_api_key (Resource)

Create an organization-scoped API key using the provider's admin API key. Requires Langfuse Enterprise. Use this key for projects and memberships. Secret values are returned only at creation and are retained in Terraform state; use a secure state backend. Changing organization_id replaces the key. Import is not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langfuse_organization" "example" {
  name = "Example Organization"
}

resource "langfuse_organization_api_key" "example" {
  organization_id = langfuse_organization.example.id
}

output "organization_secret_key" {
  value     = langfuse_organization_api_key.example.secret_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The Langfuse organization the key belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The API key ID.
- `public_key` (String, Sensitive) The public value of the API key (only returned at creation time).
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The secret value of the API key (only returned at creation time).
